title: Decouple signInWithPassword from privileged service client in security action and admin login

requirements.expectation: POST /api/security/action (change_password) checks current password using a separate anon client, not createServiceSupabase().
requirements.verification: Route test asserts service client never calls signInWithPassword; verification succeeds with separate client.
evidence: code: src/app/api/security/action/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts separate anon client is called with user email and current password, and createServiceSupabase().auth.signInWithPassword is never called.

requirements.expectation: Stray signInWithPassword call with email: '' is completely removed from security/action route.
evidence: code: diff check in src/app/api/security/action/route.ts confirms the email: '' sign-in call is deleted; grep shows no blank email sign-ins.

requirements.expectation: POST /api/admin/auth/login signs in via a separate client, preserving service_role on createServiceSupabase() for profile queries.
requirements.verification: Route test asserts service client never calls signInWithPassword; admin profile query executes under service client.
evidence: code: src/app/api/admin/auth/login/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts authClient.auth.signInWithPassword handles credentials while createServiceSupabase().auth.signInWithPassword is never called and profiles query succeeds.

requirements.expectation: Password validation and admin session cookie packaging behave identically to production specifications.
requirements.verification: Unit tests for change_password and admin login verify success and failure responses.
evidence: code: route tests assert 403 on invalid current password for change_password, 401 on bad credentials for admin login, and successful session cookie generation on valid admin login.

requirements.expectation: Full test suite, typecheck and lint pass without errors.
evidence: code: 202 Vitest files (1,831 tests) pass; tsc --noEmit exits 0; eslint exits 0 with 0 errors.

external: Deployed smoke check for change_password and admin login on non-production environment.
